tool.name: MakePlumed
tool.description: : Generate PLUMED input for biased dynamics using an MDAE model.

param.name: input_model_pth_path
param.label: input PTH file
param.help: Path to the trained PyTorch model (.pth) to be converted to TorchScript and used in PLUMED. Format: [input].pth

param.name: input_stats_pt_path
param.label: input PT file
param.help: Path to statistics file (.pt) produced during featurization, used to derive the PLUMED features.dat content. Format: [input].pt

param.name: input_reference_pdb_path
param.label: input PDB file
param.help: Path to reference PDB used for FIT_TO_TEMPLATE actions when Cartesian features are present. Format: [input].pdb

param.name: input_ndx_path
param.label: input NDX file
param.help: Path to GROMACS index (NDX) file used to define groups when required by PLUMED. Format: [input].ndx

param.name: outname_output_plumed_dat_path
param.label: output DAT name
param.help: Path to the output PLUMED input file Format: [output].dat

param.name: outname_output_features_dat_path
param.label: output DAT name
param.help: Path to the output features.dat file describing the CVs to PLUMED Format: [output].dat

param.name: outname_output_model_ptc_path
param.label: output PTC name
param.help: Path to the output TorchScript model file (.ptc) for PLUMED's PYTORCH_MODEL action Format: [output].ptc

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: include_energy
param.label: include_energy
param.help: Whether to include ENERGY in PLUMED.

param.name: bias
param.label: bias
param.help: List of biasing actions (e.g. METAD) to be added to the PLUMED file. (Json)

param.name: prints
param.label: prints
param.help: PRINT command parameters (e.g. ARG, STRIDE, FILE). (Json)

param.name: group
param.label: group
param.help: GROUP definition options (label, NDX group or atom selection parameters). (Json)

param.name: wholemolecules
param.label: wholemolecules
param.help: WHOLEMOLECULES options when using Cartesian coordinates. (Json)

param.name: pytorch_model
param.label: pytorch_model
param.help: PYTORCH_MODEL options (label, PACE and other parameters). (Json)
